# Assets · Objects

27 files under `assets/Objects/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for 1m-d.png>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Tactile 3D renders (terrazzo, pale wood, money-green felt) on transparent grounds. Use as illustrations in `FeatureCard` and `Hero`, on `surface` or `surface-subtle`, one object per idea.

`-d` = desktop crop, `-m` = mobile crop, `-sq` = square. `eur-and-gbp-on-green` has a full green ground with window-shadow light, for full-bleed brand bands. `pound.png` is a white £ glyph on black: a typographic reference, not page imagery.
